proof:
The hypotheses $3\ell/7<c<\ell/2$ ensure $0\le c\le\ell$ and strict nonheaviness. Apply the exact symmetric-padding depth theorem to obtain the actual critical ambient cover and the global raw depth $B$. At $\alpha=B$ all the positive parts vanish. With $M=(6\ell+4c)V$ and $B=(3\ell+c)V$ the mass defect is $M-9B/4=(7c-3\ell)V/4$, positive by hypothesis. As $B>0$, this is equivalent to $(3B-M)/B<3/4$.

For the stated instance the padding cube has $V=1$, $\varepsilon\max_L|v|=1/4<1+c$, and $2>1+c+1/4=17/10$, so the cap conditions hold simultaneously. In order of bases $-1,0,1$ and caps $H_0,H_+,H_-$, the masses are
$$
\begin{pmatrix}
11/20&0&2\\
47/20&29/20&29/20\\
11/20&2&0
\end{pmatrix}.
$$
These are the retained-length formulas of the product theorem, with padding volume one. The three full fibers have masses $2,19/5,2$. Thus $M=39/5$, $B=69/20$, $B/M=23/52$, $M-9B/4=3/80$, $4/9-B/M=1/468$ and $(3B-M)/B=17/23$.
statement:
For $d\ge2$ take $\ell>0$, $3\ell/7<c<\ell/2$, and a centrally symmetric convex body $L\subseteq\mathbb R^{d-1}$ centered at zero, of volume $V$. Let $C=\{(z,x,w): |z|\le1,\ -\ell\le x\le\ell+4c(1-|z|),\ w\in L\}$ with its summed integer-fiber volumes. For a nonzero linear functional $v$ and $\varepsilon>0$ with $\varepsilon\max_L|v|<\ell+c$, choose $A>\ell+c+\varepsilon\max_L|v|$ and use $H_0=\{x\ge c\}$, $H_\pm=\{x\le c\pm(Az+\varepsilon v(w))\}$. All fibers are strictly nonheavy and the positively dependent rank-two critical cap cover has equal masses $A_i=B$. The ordinary three-cap profile with coefficient $\gamma_2=4/9$ fails for the actual total mixed masses at $\alpha=B$:
$$
M-\left(\sum_{i=0,+,-}(A_i-\alpha)_++\frac{\alpha}{\gamma_2}\right)
=\frac{(7c-3\ell)V}{4}>0.
$$
Equivalently $(3B-M)/B<3/4$. For $\ell=1,c=9/20$, $L=[-1/2,1/2]^{d-1}$, $v(w)=w_1$, $\varepsilon=1/2$, $A=2$, the total mass is $39/5$, the maximum raw depth is $69/20$, and the normalized maximum is $23/52$. The mass defect is $3/80$, the deficit relative to $4/9$ in normalized depth is $1/468$, and the overlap ratio is $17/23$.
title: Actual critical rank-two caps can violate the ordinary three-cap profile
